claims.text: In a rain-fed multi-location field trial on smallholder fields across four districts in South Ethiopia during the 2022/23 main cropping season, 11 bread-wheat genotypes were tested. G11 had the highest reported mean grain yield (2.83 t/ha), but its yield was not statistically distinguishable from G8, G9, and G10. This result applies to those trial entries, sites, and season; it is not a global yield estimate or a species-wide ranking.
claims.textZh: 在 2022/23 年主要种植季于南埃塞俄比亚四个地区的小农田开展的一项雨养多地点田间试验中，研究测试了 11 个面包小麦基因型。G11 报告的平均籽粒产量最高（2.83 吨/公顷），但在籽粒产量比较中与 G8、G9 和 G10 无统计学显著差异。该结果仅适用于这些试验材料、地点和季节；它不是全球产量估计，也不构成物种层面的排名。

claims.text: In an eight-day chemotherapy mouse model, tongue samples from 6–9-week-old female C57BL/6 mice receiving 5-fluorouracil plus daily Candida albicans SC5314 had higher endogenous bacterial loads than samples from mice receiving 5-fluorouracil alone. Both CFU and 16S rRNA gene-copy assays showed the difference at day 8 (p=0.008; 4–10 mice per group across 1–2 experiments). This is specific to the laboratory strain and perturbed mouse model; it does not establish natural fungal ecology or human clinical outcomes.
claims.textZh: 在为期八天的化疗小鼠模型中，接受 5-氟尿嘧啶并每日给予白色念珠菌 SC5314 的 6–9 周龄雌性 C57BL/6 小鼠，其舌部样本的内源细菌负荷高于仅接受 5-氟尿嘧啶的小鼠。CFU 和 16S rRNA 基因拷贝数检测均显示第 8 天存在差异（p=0.008；每组 4–10 只小鼠，来自 1–2 次独立实验）。该结果仅适用于这一实验室菌株和受扰动的小鼠模型，不能据此推断自然真菌生态或人类临床结局。

claims.text: In a captive broodstock experiment, females fed a mixed-crustacean diet produced 78.1±6.5 egg clusters per kg body weight, compared with 31.1±13.3 in the mixed-fish diet group; each diet group contained four females. The broodstock originated as wild sub-adults caught in the Ionian Sea near Gallipoli, Italy, and were then kept in a recirculating aquaculture system in Cesenatico. This diet-group result describes captive reproduction, not fecundity in wild populations.
claims.textZh: 在一项圈养亲本实验中，混合甲壳类饲料组雌性每千克体重产卵团数为 78.1±6.5，混合鱼类饲料组为 31.1±13.3；每种饲料组均有四只雌性。亲本为从意大利加利波利附近爱奥尼亚海捕获的野生亚成体，之后在切塞纳蒂科的循环水养殖系统中饲养。该饲料组结果描述的是圈养繁殖，并非野外种群的繁殖力。
